title: 😬 This Republican Senator Just Had a Catastrophic 48 Hours | Chris Cillizza
description:
🚨 Could one of America’s safest Republican Senate seats suddenly be in play?

Kansas Senator Roger Marshall just endured a brutal 48 hours. First, Donald Trump targeted Bombardier—a Canadian aerospace company that employs more than 1,200 people in Wichita—forcing Marshall to balance loyalty to Trump with protecting Kansas jobs. ✈️😬

Then came a damaging New York Times investigation into Marshall’s former medical practice, which reportedly sued hundreds of patients over unpaid bills. Dozens were ultimately arrested after missing court appearances. 🏥⚖️

Now Marshall faces Adam Hamilton, a first-time Democratic candidate who founded one of America’s largest United Methodist churches. Recent Democratic-sponsored polls suggest a close race—but Democrats haven’t won a Kansas Senate seat since 1932. 🌻🗳️

Could this become the election’s biggest upset—or is Kansas still safely Republican? 🤔
